text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Not yet... not yet...â If I just... dig 
deep at the end...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...!? What incredible spirit... She 
shouldn't be able to reach me anymore... 
so why...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
You're... "that" kind of person, aren't 
you...! Mejiro Ramonu...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahh...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: This year's Japanese Oaks champion is...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ramonu ran so well, and yet... That 
presence of hers is something no one else 
could ever replicate.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...That's right. Defeat doesn't suit an 
Umamusume like her. Lady Ramonu's story... 
doesn't end here!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"For the Shuka Sho... I want to see 
Ramonu-sama on the throne! No, she MUST 
show it to us...!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oooooh...! Mejiro Ramonu...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Ah... Geez.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"You're the only one. The only one who 
drives me... so crazy."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "...I truly, love you."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Look at me... Look at me, running solely 
for you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"At the Shuka Sho—a sublime race. I will 
dedicate it, without fail..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu suffered a regrettable 
defeat. However... it did not diminish her 
strength in the slightest. Rather...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her running is polished further and 
further even amidst fierce races. It feels 
as though her legs will stretch out 
infinitely without end.
choice_data_list: (I want to see more of her "love.")

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the racing I love so much... and more 
than that, right now, a desire to keep 
witnessing Mejiro Ramonu's love... her 
running, is awakening inside me.
choice_data_list: (Beyond the Tiara, and what lies ahead—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I'm very... disappointed. From the bottom 
of my heart.
choice_data_list: Still, that was a magnificent run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ... You truly mean that, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I mean...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
A flushed face. Isn't it a bit too early 
for summer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Summer... Speaking of which, Tracen 
Academy holds a summer training camp to 
improve the Umamusume's skills, and Mejiro 
Ramonu will also be participating."
choice_data_list:
This summer, let's sharpen your running 
even more

This summer, let's sharpen your running 
even more

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Stepping away from the turf is lonely, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"If I polish myself while we're apart... 
our love will only grow deeper."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Let us nurture it. Deep within this 
heart... slowly and carefully.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, to ensure victory in the final 
race of the Triple Tiara, the Shuka Sho... 
days of training began once again.
